basics.name: Akash Raj
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 6+ years of experience building AI-enabled products, developer tools, data platforms, and high-performance web and mobile applications. Experienced in TypeScript, Node.js, React, React Native, Docker, and AWS, with a track record of owning systems end to end.

highlights: Built an agentic software-development platform that converts product requirements into production-ready code and auditable pull requests, reducing implementation and review time by 70%.
Developed comprehensive end-to-end test suites that catch defects early, improve release confidence, and reduce debugging and triage effort.
Built robust parsers for complex financial documents, enabling accurate data extraction and automation.
Developed reusable, high-performance UI components.
Led a team of two developers to deliver high-impact projects.
Engineered a cross-platform React Native library for performant, scalable on-device AI model execution.
Designed a React Native data-collection application that helped double the customer base.
Partnered with machine-learning and analytics teams to build tools that improved productivity and delivery.
Interviewed and evaluated engineering candidates, helping grow a high-quality talent pool.
Delivered 10+ full-stack systems that improved data review, monitoring, operations, and communication workflows across multiple front-end platforms.
Independently owned and maintained a portfolio of full-stack projects for more than two years.
Modernized legacy codebases, improving performance and reducing maintenance overhead.
Developed and commercialized a JavaScript library for detecting cheating in online exams; it was later acquired by a leading proctoring company.
Built automation and proactive alerting systems for data aggregation, ingestion, and quality monitoring.
Developed four core modules for an online learning platform and launched websites for partner institutions.
Managed databases and servers supporting the platform.
Built a custom data-collection and analytics application that saved an NGO thousands of hours each month.
Studied and applied a range of machine-learning techniques under expert mentorship.
Led the successful completion of the Deep Dance project.

projects.name: Geographic Information System for the Government of India
projects.description: A GIS platform for working with large satellite imagery on low-end computers.
highlights: Developed a rendering engine optimized for huge satellite images.
Created image-processing and tiling pipelines for TIFF imagery.
Designed and developed annotation and report-generation modules.

projects.name: GitStats
projects.description: An open-source GitHub contribution analyzer that surfaces insights about a developer's code and habits.
highlights: Reached 3,000+ page views within two days of launch.

projects.name: SVG Animation Generator
projects.description: A tool for creating and exporting animated SVG text without runtime dependencies.
highlights: Offers a choice of 991 fonts and produces standalone CSS animations.

projects.name: Information Universe
projects.description: A web application that presents information in an easily digestible graph format.
highlights: Built a custom script that collects information from Wikipedia in real time.

projects.name: Image2Audio
projects.description: A highly optimized Java program that encodes images as audio, allowing the image to be viewed in the audio spectrogram.
highlights: Explores applications in steganography, security, and communication.

publications: Deep Dance — showcasing the capabilities of RNNs and CNNs on a video dataset
